root_cause.text: intel_hdcp_gsc_check_status() in the DRM/XE HDCP path dereferenced tile->media_gt without validating that media_gt was allocated, even though media GT can be disabled via configfs and left NULL.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE and commit message state that “when media GT is disabled via configfs, there is no allocation for media_gt, which is kept as NULL,” and the patch moves `struct xe_gsc *gsc = &gt->uc.gsc;` until after a new `if (!gt) return false;` check, preventing the page fault from evaluating `gt->uc.gsc`.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: intel_hdcp_gsc_check_status() in the DRM/XE HDCP path dereferenced tile->media_gt without validating that media_gt was allocated, even though media GT can be disabled via configfs and left NULL.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE and commit message state that “when media GT is disabled via configfs, there is no allocation for media_gt, which is kept as NULL,” and the patch moves `struct xe_gsc *gsc = &gt->uc.gsc;` until after a new `if (!gt) return false;` check, preventing the page fault from evaluating `gt->uc.gsc`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a media GT presence check before accessing GSC state so HDCP2.x status handling safely skips platforms where media GT is missing or disabled.
intent_record.what: The function changes the `gsc` declaration from immediate initialization (`struct xe_gsc *gsc = &gt->uc.gsc;`) to a separate declaration and later assignment, inserts a new early check for `!gt` that logs a debug message and returns `false`, then assigns `gsc = &gt->uc.gsc;`, and removes the `!gsc` portion from the subsequent condition so it only checks `!xe_uc_fw_is_available(&gsc->fw)`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now safely handles systems where `tile->media_gt` is absent or disabled by returning `false` before dereferencing `gt`, preventing a null-pointer dereference when accessing `gt->uc.gsc`. It also makes the later `gsc` null check unnecessary because `gsc` is always derived from a validated `gt`.

grouping_result.intent: Add a media GT presence check before accessing GSC state so HDCP2.x status handling safely skips platforms where media GT is missing or disabled.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly adds a NULL/presence check for media_gt before accessing GSC state in the HDCP2.x path, which addresses the root cause of dereferencing tile->media_gt without validation when media GT is disabled or unallocated.

candidates.rationale: This assigns tile->media_gt without validating that media_gt exists; on platforms where media GT is disabled and NULL, subsequent use of gt leads directly to the vulnerable NULL dereference.
This is the direct dereference of gt derived from tile->media_gt; if media_gt is NULL, taking &gt->uc.gsc triggers the crash described in the root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This is the actual NULL dereference: gt comes from tile->media_gt and is used without validating that media_gt was allocated. When media_gt is NULL, dereferencing gt->uc.gsc crashes.

This statement propagates tile->media_gt into gt without any presence check. It is part of the vulnerable sequence because subsequent code assumes gt is valid even though media_gt may be NULL when media GT is disabled.
